title: Control-panel reference
lead: The control panel is separate from theme selection, Player Config, and track menus inside the Player. Check each control's input type and the resulting behavior.

controls.label: VOD HLS
controls.description: The initial source. Pages plays a 60-second Big Buck Bunny excerpt.

controls.label: VOD DASH
controls.description: Play the same bundled 60-second Pages media using DASH.

controls.label: Live DASH + DVR
controls.description: Use the public live source to check rewind, multiple audio tracks, and subtitles. Availability depends on the provider.

controls.label: Live HLS
controls.description: Play a public HLS live source. The available rewind range depends on its media and loading state.

controls.label: VOD + Sprites
controls.description: Move the pointer over the seek bar to inspect previews cropped from a sprite sheet.

controls.label: VOD + Multi-audio
controls.description: Select between two tracks in the Player's audio menu. Language labels on the Pages media are test metadata.

controls.label: VOD + Subtitles
controls.description: Choose English in the Player's subtitle menu to check WebVTT subtitle rendering.

controls.label: Go to live edge
controls.description: Move to the current live edge. This does not move to the start or end of an on-demand clip.

controls.label: Offset from edge (s)
controls.description: Zero is the live edge; negative values are earlier positions. The initial display is -30. Entering a value alone does not move playback.

controls.label: Seek
controls.description: Move to the entered offset. The request is clamped to the available DVR window.

controls.label: -10s
controls.description: Move ten seconds behind the live edge, not ten seconds back from the current position.

controls.label: -30s
controls.description: Move 30 seconds behind the live edge, not 30 seconds back from the current position.

controls.label: -60s
controls.description: Move 60 seconds behind the live edge, not 60 seconds back from the current position.

controls.label: -120s
controls.description: Move 120 seconds behind the live edge, not 120 seconds back from the current position.

controls.label: Allow DVR (timeShift)
controls.description: Allow live rewind. Changing this setting recreates the Player. It starts enabled.

controls.label: Double-click
controls.description: Choose fullscreen toggling, or ten-second backward/forward seeking on the left/right half. This applies to themes other than Default.

controls.label: Start offset behind edge (s)
controls.description: Set the start position after reloading. The initial display is -20 and the reference is explicitly end.

controls.label: Reload at offset
controls.description: Reload the source at the specified start position. Unlike a seek, this also restarts local QoE session measurements.

controls.label: Buffer target (s)
controls.description: The forward video-buffer target. The initial display is 40 seconds.

controls.label: Set buffer target
controls.description: Apply the entered value through player.buffer.setTargetLevel. It does not change the live rewind window.

controls.label: Toggle Picture-in-Picture
controls.description: Show video in a separate small window where supported. Availability depends on the browser and operating system.

controls.label: Continuous play (auto-next)
controls.description: Toggle the Binge theme's end-of-clip countdown and automatic advance. It starts enabled.

controls.label: Autohide controls
controls.description: Hide the control bar after inactivity. This starts disabled and applies to every theme, including Default.

controls.label: Seek scrub-preview
controls.description: Choose between moving video during a drag and seeking only on release. This is separate from image thumbnails.

controls.label: Keep bar on hover
controls.description: When autohide is enabled, keep the bar visible while the pointer is over the Player.

controls.label: Speed item in settings gear
controls.description: Show playback-speed choices in the settings menu. Check a theme with its own gear, such as Premiere, Creator, or Studio.

controls.label: Snap seeks to markers
controls.description: Snap a seek near a marker to that position. Sample markers start at 120 seconds, so the 60-second Pages media cannot demonstrate this.

controls.label: Fullscreen on first play
controls.description: Enter fullscreen when the play button starts initial playback. The app's default autoplay makes this difficult to observe.

controls.label: Keep subtitles in view
controls.description: Keep overflowing subtitles within the display area. Compare using a source with subtitles.

controls.label: Disable UI storage
controls.description: Disable Player UI localStorage access, including playback preferences and resume positions. Separate from PlayerConfig storage.

controls.label: Snap range (%)
controls.description: Set how close a seek must be to a marker, as a percentage of seek-bar width. The initial display is 1.

controls.label: CEA-608 small-player px
controls.description: Set the height at which small-player caption placement changes. The initial display is 360 pixels and applies to CEA-608 captions.

controls.label: Remember playback preferences
controls.description: Store volume, mute and playback speed in the browser. Initially off. Requires UI storage; a choice already made with the preferences switch takes precedence.

controls.label: Resume VOD position
controls.description: Store VOD positions and resume on a later source load. Initially off. Requires UI storage; live streams are excluded.

controls.label: Read timestamp from URL
controls.description: Read a VOD start position such as t=30 from the query or fragment. Initially on. Reload the source after changing this setting because it applies on the first source load after UI creation.

controls.label: Preference switch in default settings
controls.description: Show the playback-preferences switch in Default and CSS themes. Initially off. Hidden when UI storage is disabled. Custom component layouts do not add this switch.

controls.label: Player UI language
controls.description: Initially en (English). Use auto for the browser language, or en, de, es, fr, nl or pt. Other languages fall back to English. Separate from the app Japanese/English selector.

controls.label: Follow subtitle language
controls.description: Use the selected subtitle language for Player UI. Initially off. If its translation is unavailable, use the configured UI language.

controls.label: PiP button
controls.description: Add a Picture-in-Picture button to a custom UI. Default and CSS themes already include the stock button and are not changed by this addition.

controls.label: AirPlay button
controls.description: Add an AirPlay button to a custom UI. It appears only in supported Safari environments.

controls.label: Chromecast button
controls.description: Add a Cast button to a custom UI. This recreates the Player to enable remotecontrol and requires a compatible receiver.
